trigger a reaction: Even a small amount of peanut can trigger a reaction in people who are allergic to nuts.
即使一點點花生也可能在對堅果過敏的人身上引發反應。
trigger a crisis: Experts warn that a sudden rise in oil prices could trigger a crisis in many poor countries.
專家警告，油價突然上漲可能會在許多貧窮國家引發危機。
trigger memories: The smell of fresh bread can trigger memories of my grandmother's kitchen when I was a little child.
新鮮麵包的香味會觸發我小時候在奶奶廚房裡的回憶。
trigger an alarm: If anyone opens the back door after ten o'clock at night, it will trigger an alarm in the office.
如果晚上十點後有人打開後門，就會觸發辦公室裡的警報。
trigger a debate: The new rule about school uniforms is likely to trigger a debate among students, teachers, and parents.
關於學校制服的新規定很可能會在學生、老師和家長之間引發辯論。
trigger an attack: For people with asthma, cold air and thick dust can easily trigger an attack, so they should wear masks.
對氣喘患者來說，冷空氣和濃厚的灰塵很容易引發發作，所以他們應該戴口罩。
pull the trigger: We have talked about moving to Taipei for years, but we are still not ready to pull the trigger.
我們談搬到台北已經好幾年了，但我們仍然還沒準備好做決定。
trim the budget: Because the school received less money this year, the principal had to trim the budget for sports events.
因為學校今年收到的經費較少，校長不得不削減運動賽事的預算。
trim costs: To survive the hard times, the company tried to trim costs by cutting travel and turning off unused lights.
為了度過難關，公司藉由減少出差和關掉不用的燈來縮減成本。
trim the hedge: Every spring my father uses big scissors to trim the hedge in front of our house so it looks neat.
每年春天我爸爸都用大剪刀修剪我們家門前的樹籬，讓它看起來整齊。
trim a speech: Before the contest, I had to trim a speech that was eight minutes long so it would fit the five-minute limit.
比賽前，我得刪減一篇長達八分鐘的演講，好符合五分鐘的限制。
trim the fat: The new manager wants to trim the fat from the company by removing useless meetings and extra paperwork.
新經理想藉由取消無用的會議和多餘的文書作業來去除公司的冗餘。
trim down: He wants to trim down before the summer vacation, so he has started jogging every morning and eating less sugar.
他想在暑假前減重，所以他開始每天早上慢跑並少吃糖。
trip over a rock: Hiking in the dark is dangerous because you may trip over a rock and fall, hurting your knees.
在黑暗中健行很危險，因為你可能會被石頭絆倒摔跤，傷到膝蓋。
trip someone up: The last few questions on the test were designed to trip students up if they did not read carefully.
考卷上最後幾題是設計來讓沒有仔細閱讀的學生出錯的。
trip the alarm: If a thief tries to climb in through the window, he will trip the alarm and the police will arrive quickly.
如果小偷試圖從窗戶爬進來，他就會觸動警報，警察會很快趕到。
trip off the tongue: The name of the new café is short and easy, so it trips off the tongue and people remember it.
這家新咖啡店的名字簡短好唸，朗朗上口，所以大家都記得住。
a guilt trip: My mother gave me a guilt trip about not calling her for a week, so I promised to call every Sunday.
我媽媽因為我一週沒打電話給她而對我進行罪惡感操控，所以我答應每個星期天都打給她。
trip the light fantastic: At the wedding party, even my shy grandparents got up to trip the light fantastic when the band played.
在婚宴上，樂團演奏時，連我害羞的爺爺奶奶都起身翩翩起舞。
triumph over adversity: The movie tells the story of a blind girl who learns to triumph over adversity and becomes a famous pianist.
這部電影講述一個盲女孩學會戰勝逆境並成為知名鋼琴家的故事。
triumph over the enemy: In the old legend, the brave king led his small army to triumph over the enemy after a long war.
在古老的傳說中，勇敢的國王在長年戰爭後帶領他的小軍隊戰勝敵人。
good triumphs over evil: Children love fairy tales because in the end good triumphs over evil and the bad wolf is always punished.
孩子們喜歡童話故事，因為最後總是邪不勝正，壞野狼總會受到懲罰。
a triumph of engineering: The bridge, built across a deep valley in only two years, is a triumph of engineering.
這座只花兩年就橫跨深谷建成的橋，是工程的勝利。
in triumph: After winning the final game, the players lifted the trophy high in triumph as thousands of fans cheered.
贏得決賽後，球員們在數千名球迷的歡呼聲中凱旋地高舉獎盃。
trouble someone for: Excuse me, could I trouble you for a glass of water? My throat feels very dry after the long speech.
不好意思，可以麻煩你給我一杯水嗎？長篇演講後我的喉嚨覺得很乾。
be troubled by: My uncle has been troubled by a bad cough for weeks, so my aunt finally took him to see a doctor.
我叔叔幾週來一直為嚴重的咳嗽所苦，所以我阿姨終於帶他去看醫生了。
trouble oneself: Please don't trouble yourself about the dirty dishes; I will wash them after all the guests leave.
請不必為那些髒碗盤費心，等客人都離開後我會洗。
a troubled mind: Taking a quiet walk along the beach at sunset can help calm a troubled mind after a stressful day.
在壓力很大的一天之後，黃昏時沿著海灘安靜散步可以幫助平靜煩亂的心。
trouble the surface: Not a single breath of wind came to trouble the surface of the lake on that calm and quiet morning.
在那個平靜無聲的早晨，沒有一絲風來擾動湖面。
don't trouble to: Don't trouble to cook dinner tonight, Mom; we can order pizza and you can get some rest.
媽，今晚不必費事煮晚餐了，我們可以叫披薩，你可以休息一下。
